title: Vibrant Earthy Spanish Chicken Paella
description: A romantic Spanish dish featuring pickles and katsuramuki-cut ingredients, this paella is a hearty and flavorful meal, halal-friendly and perfect for special occasions
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large paella pan over medium-high heat
Add the sliced pickles and cook until they start to brown
Add the katsuramuki-cut carrots and cook for 5 minutes
Add the chicken breast and cook until browned on all sides
Add the Spanish rice and stir to combine with the chicken and vegetables
Add the smoked paprika, garlic, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Add 4 cups of water to the pan and bring to a boil
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes
Remove the pan from the heat and let it rest for 5 minutes
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
Refrigerate and consume within 1 week — this preparation is not shelf-stable without an approved acid level and canning process.

Refrigerator pickle only: store in the fridge and consume within 1 week. For shelf-stable canning, add at least 2 tablespoons of vinegar (5% acidity) per cup of brine and follow a tested water-bath process.
